**Senior Manager, Non\-Financial Risk Controls Testing (International)**
========================================================================

Req ID: 123210
Department: Insto \- Non\-Financial Risk \- Controls Testing
Division: Institutional
Location: Bengaluru
**About Us**
------------

  

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our customers. Our Institutional bank helps our largest customers move trade and capital around the region, providing our people with great opportunities to build their technical expertise and their careers.

**About the Role**
------------------

  


The role focuses on serving the division by identifying opportunities to centrally monitor controls, at scale, delivering optimal Non\-Financial Risk outcomes.



The role holder is accountable for supporting the execution of the Control Self\-Assessment (CSA) process in partnership with Control Owners in Institutional’s International businesses. CSA is applied to Controls across assigned products, processes, and value chains within the First Line of Defence. It uses data‑driven methods to assess control design and operating effectiveness, highlights non‑compliance and thematic issues, and translates findings into clear, prioritized remediation and continuous‑improvement actions.



This role champions uplift in design, automation and coverage, ensures testing work is well‑governed, traceable, and timely, whilst adhering to enterprise risk standards and regulatory obligations. This role partners closely with the businesses Control Owners and risk subject matter experts to strengthen the end‑to‑end control environment and risk culture, influencing stakeholders to embed sustainable, root cause focused remediation.



Role Type: Permanent  

Role Location: Bangalore

  



Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

* Assess the design and operating effectiveness of business processes and controls through control monitoring/testing.

**Strengthen Risk Capability and Control Ownership Across the Business:**


* Partner with Control Owners, business stakeholders and 2nd/3rd line to build a shared understanding of NFR, Controls and testing/monitoring expectations.

* Align monitoring/testing activities with broader enterprise risk management frameworks and regulatory expectations to promote a consistent, well‑governed control environment.
**What will you bring?**
------------------------



To grow and succeed in this role, you will ideally bring:

  


* 7\+ years of institutional international business experience across one or more countries, with a strong focus on Non\-Financial Risk.
* Proven people management experience, including leading and developing high\-performing teams.
* Strong understanding of control monitoring and assessment methodologies, including evaluating both control design and operating effectiveness.
* Deep knowledge of non\-financial risk frameworks, risk obligations, and applicable regulatory standards.
* Solid understanding of governance expectations, documentation requirements, and evidence management standards.
* Knowledge of data analytics concepts and data structures, with the ability to leverage data to inform Risk and Control Assessments (RCAs) and control monitoring activities.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate and build effective partnerships across business and risk teams to strengthen and enhance control effectiveness.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical findings into clear, actionable insights and recommendations.
* Strong planning, prioritization, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple monitoring activities and competing deadlines.
* Exceptional attention to detail, supported by strong discipline in governance, documentation, testing, and evidence retention practices.
**So why join us?**
-------------------

  




ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. * Protect the global product core while accounting for legitimate country, policy and operational differences.



**Work deeply with technology and data** 



* Collaborate closely with engineering, architecture, data, security and enterprise IT teams.
* Understand APIs, system integrations, identity, data models, events, permissions and failure scenarios.
* Use SQL, analytics tools or structured data exploration to answer product questions independently.
* Define instrumentation before launch and use evidence not anecdotes to assess outcomes.
* Challenge point\-to\-point fixes that create long\-term complexity or operational risk.
* Consider reliability, privacy, security and scalability part of the product—not post\-launch checklists.



**Make AI useful, trusted and measurable** 



* Identify problems where AI can materially improve speed, quality or cost not simply add an AI label.
* Help develop grounded assistants, intelligent workflows and automation.
* Define evaluation datasets, quality thresholds, escalation paths and human accountability.
* Measure successful task completion, outcome quality, time saved, cost per successful task and user trust.
* Stop or redesign AI use cases that do not meet quality, fairness, security or economic thresholds.



**Drive decisions and execution** 



* Prioritise ruthlessly across user pain, business value, risk, effort and strategic fit.
* Align senior stakeholders without relying on endless meetings or consensus.
* Surface trade\-offs early and communicate decisions clearly.
* Work through dependencies and operational constraints to get products shipped.
* Stay close to adoption after launch and take ownership of business outcomes—not merely feature delivery.



  





**You’ll thrive here if you** 



* Have 3–5 years of Core product management experience
* Are street\-smart and resourceful: you can make progress even when the process, ownership or data is imperfect.
* Are intellectually curious and willing to go several layers deeper than the initial request.
* Can process conflicting inputs without becoming paralysed or turning the roadmap into a stakeholder wish list.
* Have strong product judgment and know when to use research, data, first principles or a fast experiment.
* Are technically fluent enough to have meaningful conversations about APIs, data flows, integrations, identity and system reliability \& can get your hands dirty when required to build.
* Can communicate equally well with an engineer, an HR operations specialist, a store manager and a senior executive.
* Prefer solving a meaningful problem over shipping a fashionable feature.



**Technical comfort we’re looking for** 




 You do not need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable with several of the following:
 


* REST APIs, webhooks and system integrations
* Relational data models and basic SQL
* Identity, roles and permissions
* Event\-driven workflows and automation
* Product analytics and experimentation
* AI/LLM concepts such as retrieval, evaluation, grounding and Evals
* Security, privacy and data\-residency considerations
* Enterprise platforms such as HRMS, ATS, payroll, CRM or workflow systems



**What you can expect from this role** 



* Real ownership, not backlog administration.
* Problems that sit at the intersection of people, technology and global scale.
* Space to experiment with AI, with clear expectations around evidence and responsibility.
* A high\-learning environment where curiosity, speed and depth are valued.



**A note before you apply** 




 You do not need to match every bullet. We care more about how you think, learn and operate than whether your previous job title was perfect.

They relentlessly pursue clean data, identifying and remediating orphaned, incomplete, and inaccurate records before they undermine reporting, and they apply AI to automate the manual, repetitive work of reporting and data governance. jobs.description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The ServiceNow Business Analyst (ITSM specialism) is a key member of the NTT DATA ServiceNow Practice, embedded within a product domain and working closely with the Product Owner, Delivery Manager, and development team. The role is responsible for gathering, translating, and managing business requirements through the full delivery lifecycle — from stakeholder workshops through to development story creation, testing coordination, and release sign\-off.
   

  

 The BA acts as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical delivery, ensuring that what is built accurately reflects the outcomes the business needs and aligns to the product roadmap. Although domain\-aligned, the BA is part of a shared pool and may support other capability areas when capacity requires.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead and facilitate workshops with business stakeholders to elicit, capture, and validate requirements, ensuring outcomes and objectives are clearly understood before entering the development pipeline.
* Translate business requirements into clearly written, development\-ready user stories, acceptance criteria, and process maps in line with the agreed product roadmap.
* Own and maintain the requirements backlog for the product domain, keeping stories refined, prioritised, and ready for sprint intake in collaboration with the Product Owner.
* Support the Sprint Intake Review by ensuring stories are sufficiently detailed and acceptance criteria are agreed before development begins.
* Coordinate and actively participate in functional testing and UAT, validating that developed functionality meets the defined acceptance criteria and business outcome.
* Act as a liaison between the business and QA function to ensure test cases are aligned to requirements and that business stakeholders are engaged in sign\-off activities.
* Identify and document scope changes, risks, and dependencies, escalating to the Delivery Manager and Product Owner where appropriate.
* Contribute to Release Readout sessions, supporting communication of what has been delivered and gathering feedback for continuous improvement.
* Maintain clear and accurate requirements documentation throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring traceability from requirement through to delivery.
* Support the ITSM Product Owner in refining the ITSM/ITOM/ITAM/SAM roadmap by providing detailed requirements context for incoming demand.
* Document and optimise IT service management processes — including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Asset workflows — ensuring alignment to ServiceNow best practice and ITIL principles.
* Engage with IT operations stakeholders to understand service desk and operations pain points, translating these into platform improvements.


**Essential Experience \& Skills**
* Proven experience as a Business Analyst in an enterprise IT or digital transformation environment.
* Strong skills in requirements elicitation, workshop facilitation, and stakeholder management across multiple levels of seniority.
* Experience writing high\-quality user stories and acceptance criteria for agile development teams.
* Ability to coordinate and support testing activities, including defining test scenarios, coordinating UAT, and managing sign\-off processes.
* Excellent communication and documentation skills — able to translate complex business needs into clear, actionable requirements.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, agile delivery environment with multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Demonstrable experience working on ServiceNow ITSM implementations or enhancements, with a solid understanding of ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, or SAM modules.
* Familiarity with ITIL frameworks and how they translate into ServiceNow configuration.
* Experience engaging with IT operations teams, service desk functions, or technology stakeholders as part of requirements gathering.


**Desirable**
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) or relevant product certification.
* Experience working in a product\-led, platform delivery model.
* Familiarity with Now Create methodology or ServiceNow implementation best practice.
* Experience with Agile tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or ServiceNow Agile Development.


**Behaviours \& Competencies**
* Outcome\-focused — driven by business value, not just task completion.
* Collaborative — builds trust with business stakeholders and delivery teams alike.
* Detail\-oriented — takes pride in the quality and accuracy of requirements and documentation.
* Proactive — surfaces risks, gaps, and opportunities without waiting to be asked.
* Adaptable — comfortable operating in a shared pool model across different capability domains
